arguments.sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN s.weight_kg IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
        WHEN s.weight_kg = 0 THEN 'zero'
        WHEN s.weight_kg < 0 THEN 'negative'
        WHEN typeof(s.weight_kg) <> 'integer' THEN typeof(s.weight_kg)
        ELSE 'positive integer'
    END AS weight_kind,
    COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 END) AS no_colour_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END) AS blue_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour LIKE '%blue%' AND c.colour <> 'Blue' THEN 1 END) AS other_blue_labels,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unmatched_eye_colour,
    MIN(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg > 0 THEN s.weight_kg END) AS lowest_positive_weight
FROM main.superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN main.colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
GROUP BY weight_kind
ORDER BY weight_kind
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 END)
    - COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END) AS difference
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL
LIMIT 1
